title: Refero Styles has 2,000 free design files to copy any app's look
description:
Refero Styles: https://styles.refero.design/

"Make it look like Linear" gets you nothing.

The AI has never seen Linear.

It guesses at what the name means.

You get a purple gradient and a glass card.

Screenshots don't fix it either.

It reads the picture, not the rules.

Refero Styles solves that.

Over 2,000 design files on one site.

Each product gets a single md file.

It describes exactly how that product looks.

The type. The spacing. The color. The feel.

And it's written for your AI to read.

So it replicates the style instead of guessing.

Pick the product you like.

Paste the file. Ten seconds.

Like handing over a brand guide.

Not pointing at a photo.

Go find the look you want.

#refero #uidesign #claudecode #webdesign #aitools
